title: Rollout execution: Kernel auto-selection v2 staged enablement + tracking + sign-offs
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Goal
Execute the staged rollout for kernel selector v2 (table-driven) in runtime-1.19 with explicit guardrails, monitoring, and sign-offs across Runtime + SRE + Release Eng.

Scope (this ticket)
- Own the rollout run (timeline, cohorts, config PRs, checkpoints)
- Confirm prerequisites are met (perf gates, dashboards, rollback tools)
- Track results at each stage and collect required sign-offs
- Coordinate comms (internal + customer support readiness)

Not in scope
- Implement selector logic / registry entries (covered by ENG-3923/3926/etc.)
- Build dashboards/alerts from scratch (ENG-3933), but we verify they’re in place and correct

Key stakeholders
- Release owner: Connor O’Brien (assignee)
- Runtime approval: Hiro Tanaka / Sofia Ivanova / Noah Patel
- SRE approval: Allison Grant + Aisha Bello
- Telemetry sanity: Logan Wright / Thomas Baird (cardinality)

Links / artifacts
- Confluence: sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/selector-v2-rollout-slo-guardrails.json
- Confluence runbook: sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/kernel-and-scheduling/kernel-selector-override-and-rollback-runbook.json
- Drive checklist: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime/kernel-selector-v2-rollout-checklist.json
- Benchmark results rollup: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime/kernel-selector-v2-benchmark-results-internal.json
- Release notes draft: sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/release-notes/runtime-1-19-kernel-selector-v2.json
- Config PR (5% cohort): sources/github/redwood/pr_18547_canary_rollout_config_us_east_5_percent.json

Prereq checklist (must be green before enabling any external traffic)
[ ] Feature flag + kill switch + override precedence merged and deployed (ENG-3931)
[ ] Perf-canary gate in CI active and passing for selector-v2 experiments (ENG-3930)
[ ] Selector telemetry meets standards (sampling + bucketing), cardinality reviewed (ENG-3927)
[ ] Conformance tests covering selected kernels across buckets (ENG-3928)
[ ] SRE dashboards + alerts updated with selector_version breakdown + kernel heatmaps (ENG-3933 / INT-2331)
[ ] On-call runbook for rollback + emergency overrides reviewed by SRE (Kira Thompson)

Rollout plan (stages + guardrails)
Stage 0: Internal canary (Redwood dev + staging)
- Enable selector_v2 for internal traffic only.
- Gate: no correctness regressions (NaNs/shape mismatches), p95 not worse than v1 by >2% on internal perf smoke.

Stage 1: Hosted canary 5% (single region)
- Cohort: Hosted API, us-east, 5% of orgs (exclude known long-context heavy tenants initially).
- Duration: minimum 24h.
- Required dashboards:
  - selector_version adoption (v1 vs v2)
  - p95 latency by GPU SKU (L4/A10/A100/H100) and by prefill/decode
  - error rate + NaN/overflow counters
  - kernel_choice distribution (bucketed) + top offenders
- Gate:
  - p95 latency regression <= 3% overall and <= 5% per-SKU (relative to pre-canary baseline)
  - no sustained error-rate increase > 0.05% absolute
  - no new NaN clusters above baseline noise (any confirmed NaN regression = immediate rollback)

Stage 2: Hosted 25% (same region set)
- Duration: minimum 24–48h.
- Gate: same as Stage 1, plus verify no new cardinality spikes from telemetry.

Stage 3: Dedicated opt-in
- Enable via per-cluster config for 2–3 pilot Dedicated customers (support-informed).
- Provide kernel pin/override instructions to CSM/support.
- Gate: customer confirms stable latency + no output issues for 72h.

Stage 4: Default-on for Hosted (expand regions)
- Gradual: region-by-region with a pause after first non-us-east region.
- Gate: same; require SRE sign-off per region group if tail latency differs materially.

Rollback criteria (at any stage)
- Any confirmed correctness issue attributable to kernel choice (NaNs, incorrect shapes, determinism violations)
- p95 regression > 5% on any major SKU sustained for >30 minutes (and correlated with selector_v2)
- Elevated 5xx/timeout rates sustained >15 minutes and correlated with selector_v2

Rollback procedure (summary)
- Flip kill switch to force v1 selector (global) OR apply per-model-family safe-kernel override if isolated.
- Confirm within 15 minutes:
  - selector_version returns to v1
  - p95 returns within 2% of pre-change baseline
  - error signals stop trending
- Post-rollback: open follow-up issue with repro context (GPU SKU, model family, seq bucket, kernel id).

Sign-offs (record in comments)
- Runtime: Hiro Tanaka or Sofia Ivanova
- SRE: Allison Grant or Aisha Bello
- Release Eng: Connor O’Brien

Comms plan
- Internal: #eng-runtime + #eng-sre updates at each stage boundary.
- Support readiness: share rollback runbook and known-issues notes with Support (re: SUP-8841/SUP-8874 patterns).
- Release notes: update runtime-1.19 entry with expected behavior and how to disable/pin if needed.

Success criteria
- Selector v2 enabled by default for Hosted in runtime-1.19 with no SLO regressions.
- Reduced p95 variance across SKUs vs v1 for mixed workloads (tracked in benchmark + prod).
- Clear operational playbook validated by at least one rollback drill or real event.
